covers: C32 — packet supersession recorded (fixer muse-b9, ULW packet-identity family). Landing of record: walker/ultimate-lens-walker @ 3cbb08c375 (parent 341769226b), all six blobs read back byte-identical; landed-tree selftests: test_packet_identity 24/24, test_w0_pack 0 failures, test_wiring_capture 74/74. Premise of record: the fixer seat's PREMISE.md (walker head cc9f2bcd69). Author of record muse-b7 per CB-0828, named at claim time; content supplied by the fixer (FOR-B7-C27-C30-C32.md), registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's. The surface is the walker's own record machinery, not a lens: no endpoints, no UI legs; the verification lane is the named selftest. What the build changes: upgrade_record with a prior record names the prior's packet_id in the successor's `supersedes`, bumps packet_version by one, and recomputes its own packet_id; walker.py's finalize path loads the existing lens record in the run dir (resume/re-walk) and passes it as prior; pack.py pairs prev-run records so the lens packet names the superseded packet_id from the pairing; a record whose packet_id appears in another record's `supersedes` is retired by name — mechanically checkable over a record set. Checks: (1) the supersession legs of `python3 walker/selftest/test_packet_identity.py` (successor naming, version bump, ID recompute). (2) walker.py finalize on a resume/re-walk passes the existing record as prior. (3) pack.py's pairing names the superseded packet_id in the lens packet. Adversarial: supersession across lenses raises; a bare packet_id string is accepted as prior (version parsed from its :vN segment).
discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator transcript (replayed at the fixer seat against cc9f2bcd69): `grep supersede` over the walker branch returned 8 hits, all unrelated (fold status chains, viewport zoom, findings regrade); no packet carried any supersession field. Post-fix legs in the same selftest (test_packet_identity 24/24 on the landed tree).
